column1: # Every override is an accepted risk and must say why; INFO keeps it visible in reports.

column3: Suspicious comments: matches are identifiers inside the minified React/router vendor bundle, not developer comments.
Non-storable content: index.html is deliberately Cache-Control no-store so deployments take effect immediately.
CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline': styled-components injects <style> tags at runtime and static nginx cannot issue per-request nonces. script-src stays 'self', so injected markup cannot execute script.
Modern Web Application: informational detection of a single-page app; no risk.
